summary:
# NOTES: The X Bar X Boys at Nugget Camp (James Cody Ferris, 1928, Grosset & Dunlap; illustrated Walter S. Rogers)

## Front matter / ads (non-story)
- Series list: On the Ranch; in Thunder Canyon; on Whirlpool River; on Big Bison Trail; at the Round-Up; at Nugget Camp. Later ad lists also name "At Rustler's Gap."
- Other ad series: Rover Boys (Winfield/Stratemeyer), Hardy Boys (Franklin W. Dixon; titles: Tower Treasure, House on the Cliff, Secret of the Old Mill, Missing Chums, Hunting for Hidden Gold).
- Chapter list: I A Dangerous Cast; II Out of the Depths; III Mysterious Riders; IV The Old Miner; V Belle Ada's Nerve; VI Stolen Nuggets; VII The Gold Rush; VIII Pop Lays Down the Law; IX Roy Makes a Statement; X Silent Packs a Gun; XI The Fight; XII A Crack at Fortune; XIII Off to Nugget Camp; XIV Some Shooting; XV Horsemen in the Storm; XVI His Night to Howl; XVII The Lucky Shot; XVIII Discovery; XIX The Stranger; XX Buncoed; XXI Allen's Gun; XXII On the Trail; XXIII Greyhound; XXIV Ready to Quit; XXV One Eleven Comes Through.

## People
- **Roy Manley** (17), elder brother; wears hat/handkerchief bandage; rides **Star** (pony).
- **Teddy Manley** (16, one year younger), rides **Flash**.
- **Bardwell Manley** (father, X Bar X owner, corn-cob pipe, drooping mustache, steel-blue eyes). Says "Teddy, come back the way you go!"
- **Mrs. Barbara Manley** (mother, golden hair greying).
- **Belle Ada** (sister, 13, "almost fourteen", dark-haired, practical jokes; helps Doctor Ring).
- **Nell Willis** (thrown from pony; her runaway pony caught by Roy); **Ethel "Curly" Carew**; both visiting **Mrs. Peter Ball** at the **8 X 8** ranch.
- **Peter Ball** (8 X 8 rancher, former infantry captain in WWI, France); **Mrs. Ball** (motherly).
- **Bug Eye**, young 8 X 8 puncher, drives a flivver/touring car ("Lizzie"); later goes to Nugget Camp; sells flivver to Allen for $700; later says "Three new flivvers."
- **Jules Kolto** (8 X 8 hand who fixed Star).
- **Doctor Ring**, young doctor new to region; Belle assists him.
- **Pop Burns**, oldest X Bar X hand, bald, lean, "fourteen rushes" boast; cousin **Jerry Decker** (miner, ~50-60, grey hair, tall, similar to Pop); gets a watch from Decker later.
- **Sing Lung**, cook at X Bar X ("Good wold, he fly coop").
- **Nick Looker**, early twenties, close friend of Teddy, six years at X Bar X; says "Snakes," "Yay boy," rides **Black Bottom** (pony).
- **Jim Casey** (~35), **Nat Raymond**, **Gus Tripp** (left X Bar X for gold; Gus owes Nick $3). Gus's claim at "One Hundred and Ten above discovery"; Teddy/Roy/Nick/Silent's claim "One Hundred and Eleven" (nicknamed One Eleven).
- **Rad Schmell**, puncher. **Jack Conroy**, partner of Silent; stays at ranch.
- **Silent** (alias; real name **Hap Neville**), 25-26, short, stocky, sour; father and brother killed by outlaws (robbed of $1,000 gold by two men; he was feverish on cot, ~3 months earlier, cabin ~300 miles away). Expert shot (father and brother good shots). Cook. Rode with Greyhound-hunting group.
- **Maryland** (Nugget Camp drunk with scar on forehead; Roy shoots gun from his hand; later finds gold on One Eleven's neighboring claim, returns to tell them).
- **Jimmie Allen** (tall, big-boned swindler; Mauser gun; claims $12,000 in gold; frames Nick for theft; demands $10,000; sentenced to twenty years).
- **Greyhound** (outlaw leader, 6'4", huge shoulders, arm in sling; killed Decker, Neville father & brother). Gang: Greyhound's men (one shot in arm by Teddy).
- Deputy sheriff at camp.

## Places
- X Bar X ranch (Manleys); 8 X 8 ranch (Balls); Rocky Run River; rock cliff/ledge ("the rocks", ~100 ft); pool below; clump of trees/triangular woods (scene of shooting).
- Eagles (town); Sanborn's Point (German family nearby, innocent); Harver's Gully (cattle roundup); Hawley (law, 70-80 miles); Hagerman's (saloon); Bannister's hoss farm (mules); Mike's Place (filing office); Chicago (cattle buyers).
- Nugget Camp: gambling houses, saloons, speakeasies; shaft at One Hundred and Eleven; timber and two large streams + one small stream.

## Key events in order
1. Roy chases Nell's runaway pony; Roy catches it with lariat at cliff; pony jerks, Roy falls into Rocky Run River. Teddy rescues him with rope and Flash. Brothers agree not to tell the story; Roy wears Teddy's hat; Roy's chocolate.
2. Teddy hears yell; finds Jerry Decker shot through neck (bullet in neck) under pine by trees; gun gone, pony taken. Roy binds wound. Teddy rides for help; Bug Eye brings car. Decker taken to 8 X 8. Decker says "Did they get it?" and "Where's my nugget?" Doctor Ring sedates him.
3. Mr. Ball finds German Mauser pistol (one shell fired) at scene; three horse prints.
4. Belle reports Decker's talk: Nugget Camp, "ten and twenty thousand dollars."
5. Jim Casey, Nat Raymond, Gus Tripp rush to Nugget Camp. Pop argues against rush; Roy says he'd like to join. Mr. Manley permits trip.
6. Pop reports Decker's words: strike "richest within a thousand miles"; $20,000 in nuggets.
7. Silent hired; fight with Teddy over whip with tin/lead sinkers; Teddy saves Silent from cow; Silent's family tragedy revealed by Conroy.
8. Party of Teddy, Roy, Nick, Silent (Bug Eye joins later) leaves X Bar X with three mules; Silent shoots tomato can five times ("five out of five").
9. Stormy night; horsemen (Greyhound and Allen) flee; Silent recognizes killers. Stone thrown later with note "LAY OFF" and dog picture.
10. Nugget Camp arrival; Maryland shoots at Teddy's feet; Roy shoots gun from his wrist.
11. Claim staked near Gus's (One Hundred and Eleven). Roy buried by cave-in (3.5 min), finds ~$200 nugget.
12. Bug Eye arrives; buys? (sells flivver to Allen for $700). Allen frames Nick; Bug Eye intervenes.
13. Silent recognizes Allen's German gun, reveals name "Greyhound"; Allen escapes on horse.
14. Pursuit: Silent tracks thrower; Greyhound's camp ~7 miles away; dawn capture. Greyhound says Decker's gold; Allen confesses ~$50,000 gold in tent. Greyhound: "I can't understand it..."
15. Prisoners taken to Nugget Camp; deputy sheriff. Gold recovered; Decker's nuggets returned.
16. Work at One Eleven petering out; Teddy decides to leave; Maryland finds rich pocket on One Eleven (~$40,000 total per Silent).
17. Mr. Manley's grub stake returned: $25,000 check (four times). Decker gives Belle Ada diamond bracelet; Pop receives watch and chain. Greyhound and gang convicted; Allen twenty years.

## Quoted phrases and notable lines
- "Atta baby!"; "Snakes!"; "I'll tell a maverick"; "Sweet daddy"; "For the love of Pete"; "Lay off."
- Roy: "I can't--Sweet daddy..."; Teddy: "Teddy, come back the way you go!" (Mr. Manley).
- Silent: "Not long! Not half long enough!"; "Greyhound, you're finished!" / "I give you back your life."
